content: .{@-मुख@} {%a.%} goat-faced. ({@खः@}) <ab>N.</ab> of a Prajāpati (Dakṣa). When Dakṣa reviled Śiva at his sacrificial session, Vīrabhadra pulled out his face, and afterwards at the request of Śiva himself he put up a goatʼs face in place of the original human one. . ({@-खी@}) <ab>N.</ab> of a Rākṣasī kept to watch over Sītā in the Aśoka garden at Laṅkā.
